state.persona: Tech-savvy traveler (Maya, 34, Brooklyn) who uses Claude or ChatGPT daily and wants their own AI assistant to set up their dope.travel profile over MCP and then plan a Lisbon trip with husband and 6-year-old daughter.
state.flow: The AI called dope_plan_trip and replied: "Trip to Lisbon ready. Give the traveler this private link; it opens as their trip, and they can invite the crew from there: <link>" followed by a day-by-day outline and stay search links. Traveler opens link in a fresh browser (phone).
state.visible_join_page: SHARED TRIP. Headline: "Your agent planned this. Lisbon." "Thu, Oct 15 → Tue, Oct 20 · 5 nights. Say which one is you and it opens as your trip on this device. Then invite the crew." WHO ARE YOU? chips: Maya, Dev, Anika. "Not on the list? Add yourself" input. Button "Open my trip →". Pressing without choosing shows "Tap your name, or add yourself."
state.after_open: Designer canvas for Lisbon, "Drafted on this device", "Voting as Maya/Dev/Anika", "Invite people" button, research panel. The music taste the agent passed (funk, soul, Khruangbin) is stripped from the link, so the canvas has no music taste.
state.hidden_fact: Opening the link auto-fires paid destination research (~$0.055) for any place not already cached; a nonsense place like "asdfghjkl qwerty" also yields "Trip to asdfghjkl qwerty ready."

becomes_mine.instructions: Probability the traveler understands the trip is now theirs (organizer) on this device and how to invite the crew.

who_are_you_friction.instructions: Friction of the "Who are you?" step for the person the agent planned it for.
